lead.event: Bank Central Asia announces its third interim dividend for fiscal 2026
lead.headline: BBCA announces third 2026 interim dividend of Rp4.29 trillion
lead.blurb: Bank Central Asia will pay Rp35 per share. The cum date on regular and negotiation markets is 27 November, the recording date is 1 December and payment is scheduled for 16 December. This is the final interim dividend for fiscal 2026, bringing cumulative interim dividends to Rp80 per share, up 45.5% from the previous fiscal year.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX suspends five companies over inaccurate free-float disclosures
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX suspends AKKU, BAJA, FIRE, KING and KPIG over inaccurate free-float disclosures
market_structure_policy.blurb: Anugerah Kagum Karya Utama, Saranacentral Bajatama, Alfa Energi Investama, Hoffmen Cleanindo and MNC Tourism Indonesia had inconsistencies in September share-registration reports compared with KSEI ownership data for shareholders holding above 1%. Trading in their regular and cash markets has been suspended from 27 November until further notice after the companies failed to clarify or correct the reports by 26 November.

market_structure_policy.event: MSCI removes Barito Pacific from Global Standard and downgrades Bumi Resources Minerals
market_structure_policy.headline: MSCI removes BRPT from Global Standard and downgrades BRMS to Small Cap on 1 December
market_structure_policy.blurb: MSCI announced the changes on 11 November, with index-tracking funds set to adjust portfolios after the Indonesia Stock Exchange closes on 30 November. BRIDS warned of potential ownership changes and transaction volatility ahead of the effective date. MSCI will announce its next review on 9 February 2027.

earnings_guidance.headline: KRAS reports US$6.31 million consolidated profit in first half of 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Revenue rose 36.5% to US$609.21 million from US$446.45 million a year earlier. Profit attributable to owners of the parent was US$655,000, reversing a US$107.12 million loss.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: KRAS reported consolidated net profit of US$6.31 million in the first half of 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Fortune Indonesia reports higher nine-month revenue after entering coal mining
earnings_guidance.headline: FORU reports higher nine-month revenue of Rp312.31 billion after coal entry
earnings_guidance.blurb: Export coal sales accounted for Rp292.46 billion of Fortune Indonesia's revenue for the nine months ended 30 September, while media income was Rp10.29 billion. Operating expenses of Rp226.75 billion led to a Rp61.71 billion operating loss and an approximately Rp8.2 billion net loss.

earnings_guidance.event: Jakarta Setiabudi Internasional reports January–September 2026 results
earnings_guidance.headline: JSPT reports 73% rise in January–September net profit to Rp399.2 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Jakarta Setiabudi Internasional’s revenue rose 21% to Rp2.17 trillion, while EBITDA increased 39% to Rp912.7 billion. Both figures compare January to September 2026 with the same period in 2025.
